breakpoints.note: First project parser statement that reads the remainder of the attacker-controlled pcap global header into `hdr`, materializing the version, snaplen, and linktype state that later drives the vulnerable USB fixup path.

The patch changes this exact condition to `if (linktype == DLT_USB_LINUX_MMAPPED && hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped))`, moving to the caller the full-header obligation that `fix_linux_usb_mmapped_length()` had already enforced internally.
